notes.title: Game Updated 18/07/2025
notes.content:
Various bugfixes.

- Fixed a non game breaking bug in Gytera Savannah that led to a prototype of the map.
- Added quality of life to transportation thresholds in Jashej West & East
- Removed a large number of aggro on sight enemies and replaced them with more stable variants. Riftworld and some areas remain unchanged.

notes.title: Game Updated 08/06/2025
notes.content:
Various bugfixes.

- Fixed a game breaking bug in the final dungeon if you didn't get the Medusa or Medusa Naga.
- Fixed golem exploit in Riftworld.
- Fixed collision in Riftworld
- Fixed collision in a room in Control Spire.
- Greatly weakened Viperliches in Tomb of Origin
- Slightly lowered health of Gigants in Jashej West
- Others may be undocumented.

notes.title: RPG Maker FEST 2024 mini Update
notes.content:
META REVELATIONS - RING SPIRITS was updated. Here are the list of changes/fixes.

[list]
[*] Several story illustrations were replaced.
[*] Several UI elements were updated.
[*] Tay now joins the party at level 3 rather than level 1.
[*] Some enemy monsters give more EXP/Money.
[*] Some bosses and enemies were made easier, to facilitate player progress better.
[*] Various Grammar/Spelling issues were addressed.
[*] An NPC was added to simplify "Dead Grass" sidequest and improve completion rate.
[*] A cheatcode was dummied out entirely due to bugs attached to player progress.
[*] Eriths battle sprite was adjusted.
[/list]

There is a JP localisation being worked on, but it may be a long while off. Until then, enjoy the small update here.

notes.title: Meta Revelations - Ring Spirits - Patch Notes - Updated - 1.02
notes.content:
- Fixed softlock in Staza Plateau
- Properly removes 'Stazarian Coffee' from inventory.
- Hid one debug command still present in the game.
- Menu is disabled on game startup
- Behind the scenes cleanup in code to make updates a little easier.
- Added "ALT + Enter for fullscreen mode" on startup. I have debated fullscreening by default and even tested it, but disabled it as it can crash computers for some users. Instead, you may go into fullscreen mode with the prompt guidance when starting the game. This command has always been present in the game engine, however the startup splash now highlights it.
- Weakened Gem-Eating Baelfires enemies significantly.
- Reduced spawns in the cave of origins significantly.
- Resolved an issue in the final dungeon whereby a portal could cause a severe softlock.
- Stopped an event in the Trial of Humanity from repeating if the other tile is triggered.
- Fixed a naughty fountain.
- Increased FPS in Gytera Savannah, Jasehj East and Metallia Continent Shore.
- Metallia Continent Shore has a slight overhaul visually.
- Fixed multiple chests not functioning like normal ones should.
- Weakened the Sword Guardians in "The Tomb of the Sword" slightly.
- Increased margin of error for the Wind puzzles in the 'Tomb of the Sword' for players on very low end systems.
-Included quick travel options for Canara Caverns to make travel from Orta to the Kitsunes less cumbersome.
- Included quick travel options in Tomb of the Sword.
- Added clarity that green orbs can only be used on certain towers in Tomb of the Sword.
- Fixed some weird dialogue after a certain character is taken hostage.
- Cleared a portrait properly that would not expire after declining Lyria's offer in Ankitor's Tunnels.
- Made it clearer what Riley's objectives are after the desert sequence in both the game and journal.
- Removed encryption component that somehow slipped into the old build files.
- Significantly adjusted other enemies.
- Added a cheat mode that is very hidden in the game, with one that unlocks deleted scenes. It has always been there in the game, but some clues to the passwords have been hidden somewhere...
- Removed all steam achievement compatibility. Could never get it working with this older RPG engine.


There's more fixes that I've long forgotten to include, but I figured I'd tidy this project up a bit with some little fixes to help it along. There are some more deep rooted issues that may require a bigger overhaul, but I can't promise when I will get around to them. I'm also currently looking into translating the game for other lamguages. For now, enjoy the update!

notes.title: Meta Revelations - Now on Steam!
notes.content:
After a long journey, Meta Revelations is due for release on steam for absolutely free!

As an idea that's been part of me since childhood, it's a fever dream that it's made it to this point and to that end, gives me confidence.

I hope when it releases that you take a moment to spend some time with it, and whether you have a positive or negative experience with it, I'd love to hear your feedback on it!

This is my very first completed project for Meta Revelations and I hope this is the beginning to games revolving the Edenverse.

Don't forget to wishlist the game and share on social media if such a game like this poses an interest to you.
